remarks: Welcome to the wonderful waterfront community of Marina Bay and this inviting townhome with 3 roomy levels of easy living, where you'll find a modern flair with the refreshed EIK & updated 2.5 baths! Sunlit entry level welcomes you and offers easy access to the Powder Room from both the main and lower levels. Ascend a half level to the main living area, where you'll find a spacious Living Room with a cozy Fireplace, and Sliders to a Balcony/Deck. The Dining Room is ready to host your gatherings, while the Eat-In Kitchen boasts stainless appliances and Corian Counters. The Bedroom level showcases a spacious Primary Bedroom with Sliders to a 2nd Balcony/Deck and a Full Bath with a double Shower. Two additional generous Bedrooms and a Full Hall Bath complete the upstairs. The walk-out Lower Level is ideal for hours of fun in the Family Room with Sliders to expanded Trex Patio and the Laundry area, plus 2 generous storage areas and a 1 Car Attached Garage. The complex offers a wonderful pool setting directly overlooking Long Island Sound, as well as a clubhouse to host your parties or join in community activities. Additional amenities include a bike room, kayak racks, and community grills. Ideally located in Shippan between Cummings & West Beaches, you'll enjoy the convenience of nearby shopping, restaurants, and an easy commute via I-95 or the train. This lovely home is ready for you to move right in!
